messages.subject: discourse gets funding to become a mailing list replacement
parts:
re: possible replacement for stan-users (also perhaps independently of
interest as it concerns a $500,000 going to open source software)

from https://blog.mozilla.org/blog/2015/12/10/mozilla-open-source-support-first-awards-made/

Discourse: $25,000. Discourse is online discussion forum software, used
by several Mozilla communities. Their award will be used to make email a
first-class interaction mechanism for Discourse, allowing Discourse
instances to replace and improve upon mailing lists.

Best,

Allen
